tests.name: d01_concurrent_direct_call
tests.title: the compiler flags the call of a direct module from a concurrent aspect

tests.name: d02_concurrent_managed_call
tests.title: a concurrent aspect calls a managed module

tests.name: d02_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of d02: the concurrent aspect with another input

tests.name: d03_concurrent_bare_call
tests.title: a concurrent aspect can not call an unsafe member, also by a bare name from m(*)

tests.name: d04_parallel_group
tests.title: two parallel groups run one after the other; the output of a group is in the order of start

tests.name: d05_parallel_outputs
tests.title: each started aspect writes its own element of an array; the results are ready after done

tests.name: d05_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of d05: start inside if, inputs by value, a declaration local to the group

tests.name: d06_start_exclusive
tests.title: start of an aspect without a kind word is a compile error: it is exclusive

tests.name: d07_start_outside_group
tests.title: start outside the do region of a parallel group is a compile error

tests.name: d08_same_output
tests.title: two starts of a group can not receive the same output variable ($err_output)

tests.name: d08_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of d08: an output with a computed index is checked at start: $err_output 43

tests.name: d09_parallel_error
tests.title: failed tasks do not stop the others; done raises ParallelError with the errors in the order of start

tests.name: d09_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of d09: nobody recovers the ParallelError: exit 4, one line per failed task

tests.name: d09_test2
tests.title: variation 2 of d09: retry in recover runs the whole group again

tests.name: d10_on_error_cancel
tests.title: on error cancel stops the other tasks after the first failure; they are counted, not listed

tests.name: d11_within_timeout
tests.title: within sets a deadline: a task still running gets a TimeoutError

tests.name: d12_channel_pipeline
tests.title: a pipeline: one producer, four workers and a collector connected by two channels

tests.name: d13_channel_closed
tests.title: send into a closed channel raises ChannelError, code 46

tests.name: d14_deadlock
tests.title: a consumer that waits on a channel nobody sends to is a deadlock; the error names it

tests.name: d15_atomic_counter
tests.title: eight tasks add to an Atomic(:Integer) of a managed module: the total is exact

tests.name: d16_split_batch
tests.title: split(k) and batch(n) cut a list; the parts are summed in parallel and combined by index

tests.name: d17_job_spawn
tests.title: spawn starts async procedures in a job, await waits for an async function; done waits for every task

tests.name: d18_spawn_function
tests.title: spawn of an async function is a compile error: its result would be lost

tests.name: d19_async_plain_call
tests.title: an async procedure called without spawn or await is a compile error ( b)

tests.name: d20_trait
tests.title: a class adopts a trait: it writes the required method and gets the provided one

tests.name: d21_trait_missing_method
tests.title: a class that does not write a required method of its trait is a compile error

tests.name: d22_abstract_class
tests.title: an abstract class is built only by the constructor of a subclass that writes its required method

tests.name: d23_abstract_new
tests.title: an abstract class can not be created outside the constructor of a subclass

tests.name: d24_generic_class
tests.title: a generic class is made with its type argument written; a constraint asks for a trait

tests.name: d25_nested_group
tests.title: the primary aspect opens a group of concurrent aspects; outputs keep the order of start (: only the primary aspect fans out)

tests.name: d26_nested_too_many
tests.title: an exclusive aspect starts nothing in parallel: a start in it is a compile error, the limit of two starts of is gone

tests.name: d27_start_order
tests.title: the output of a group is written in the order of start, whatever task ends first

tests.name: d28_channel_receive
tests.title: receive(@x) takes one value; a for loop takes the rest until the channel is closed

tests.name: d28_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of d28: receive from a closed, empty channel raises ChannelError 46

tests.name: d28_test2
tests.title: variation 2 of d28: a close beyond the number of senders is an error

tests.name: d29_auto_close
tests.title: a failing producer does not close its channel: the machine closes it, so the consumer ends

tests.name: d30_channel_timeout
tests.title: a wait on a channel longer than $timeout raises TimeoutError in that task

tests.name: d31_leaf_group
tests.title: a concurrent aspect may open a group that starts its own private processes; the primary aspect calls it

tests.name: d32_parallel_in_procedure
tests.title: a parallel group in a procedure is a compile error: only in the main of a primary aspect or of an aspect

tests.name: d33_job_spawn_error
tests.title: a failing spawned task does not stop the others; the done of the job raises ParallelError

tests.name: d34_trait_conflict
tests.title: two traits that provide the same method force the class to write it

tests.name: d35_library_traits
tests.title: a Printable object prints its describe; Comparable gives compare to numbers and texts

tests.name: d36_private_start_atomic
tests.title: a concurrent aspect starts its own private processes; they add to an atomic variable

tests.name: d37_private_start_plain
tests.title: a started private process uses only the thread-safe names of its aspect

tests.name: d38_primary_start_private
tests.title: a primary aspect is serial: it applies its private processes, it does not start them

tests.name: d39_concurrent_by_command
tests.title: a command does not run a concurrent aspect: it is called from a primary or an exclusive aspect

tests.name: d40_concurrent_calls_concurrent
tests.title: a concurrent aspect does not call another concurrent aspect

tests.name: d41_generic_class_two_params
tests.title: a generic class takes several type parameters, written in the same list (CLS-09)

tests.name: d42_adopt_trait
tests.title: a type adopts a trait outside its declaration: adopt Trait for Type is... end adopt; (CLS-15)

tests.name: d43_adopt_missing_method
tests.title: an adopt block must write every method that the trait requires (CLS-15)

tests.name: d44_generic_inferred_constraint
tests.title: a call without a type list is checked against the constraint too: a list of Points given to largest(:T <: Comparable) is a compile error

tests.name: d45_generic_class_constraint
tests.title: the type argument of a generic class must adopt the constraint of its parameter: Sorted(:Point) is a compile error

tests.name: d46_fmt_command
tests.title: eve fmt --check reports a file whose layout would change (trailing white space, blank lines in a row, more than one line ending at the end) and exits 1; a file in layout exits 0 (lexical.md#layout)

tests.name: d46_test1
tests.title: variation of d46: a file in layout is left alone (exit 0)

tests.name: d47_lint_command
tests.title: eve lint reports the variables, parameters, loop variables and imports that are declared and never used; a name that starts with _ is meant to be unused; exit 1 when there are warnings

tests.name: d48_exclusive_calls_concurrent
tests.title: an exclusive aspect does not apply a concurrent aspect: only the primary aspect calls one

tests.name: d49_max_parallel
tests.title: $cores is the number of hardware cores (1 to 16) and $max_parallel the tasks of a group that run at a time (default 8): a start beyond it waits until a task of the group has ended

tests.name: d50_atomic_heavy
tests.title: four tasks add 50,000 times each to an Atomic(:Integer) of a managed module: the total is exact whatever the number of cores

tests.name: d51_channel_copy
tests.title: a list sent through a channel is copied: the sender and the receiver each change their own copy

tests.name: d52_output_copy
tests.title: an input is a copy, an output is copied back at done: the parent and the task never share a list

tests.name: d53_task_garbage
tests.title: six tasks make and drop many lists and texts: each task frees its own garbage while it runs, and the sums are exact

tests.name: d54_db_tasks
tests.title: four tasks query the same database connection: the connection is one for the run and the tasks take turns, so every answer is complete
